scalingAnalysis.memoryConstraint: At 32k expansions, frontier is ~45k nodes consuming ~1.5-2.2GB. Without state pruning or off-heap serialization, a multi-day run would exhaust the 6GB heap / 8GB RSS ceiling within a few hundred thousand expansions.
scalingAnalysis.combinatorialExplosion: Branching factor on TS13 is ~4-7 actions per state. 10x compute speedup increases search depth by only log(10)/log(4) ≈ 1.6 to 2.5 steps. Raw throughput cannot overcome unguided combinatorial breadth.

rustEvaluation.potentialGain: Rust engine could eliminate structuredClone and GC, yielding estimated 4x-10x throughput for state simulation and key hashing.
rustEvaluation.risks: H5mota tower logic relies on JavaScript event lists, floor script evaluations, dynamic flags and damage formulas. A full Rust rewrite risks semantic drift where routes fail strict replay in the real game. In addition, compute speedup does not solve search direction.
